tools.name: search_bramvia_knowledge
tools.description: Search Bramvia's published guides on Dynamics 365 Business Central, ERP migrations, AI in ERP delivery, profitability diagnosis, Spanish/Polish localization (SII, Verifactu, DeCA, KSeF) and US/Canada topics (tariffs, landed cost, cyber insurance, NAV end of life). Returns matching articles with summ

tools.name: get_bramvia_article
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one Bramvia article by its slug, as Markdown. Use after search_bramvia_knowledge when you need the complete content rather than a summary.

tools.name: check_nav_support_status
tools.description: Given a Dynamics NAV version, return its Microsoft support end date, the end-of-sale date for NAV licensing, and whether the company may qualify for Microsoft's Bridge to Cloud 3 migration discount.

tools.name: estimate_migration
tools.description: Estimate the cost range and timeline of migrating to Dynamics 365 Business Central, given the current system, number of users and region. Returns Bramvia working estimates (not a quote) plus licence pricing and the factors that move the number.

tools.name: check_deca_obligation
tools.description: Spain only. Determine whether a company is affected by the DeCA (documento de control) electronic transport document obligation that applies from 5 October 2026, based on how it moves goods. Returns the obligation, who is legally responsible, the penalty range and what the system must produce.

tools.name: estimate_bridge_to_cloud_savings
tools.description: Estimate the value of Microsoft Bridge to Cloud 3 for a Dynamics NAV or GP customer moving to Business Central Online: 30% off list for a fixed three-year term. Returns annual and three-year savings for the given user mix, plus the enrolment deadline and the conditions.

tools.name: check_compliance_deadlines
tools.description: Return the compliance and platform deadlines that apply to a company by country, with dates and what each one requires. Covers Spain (Verifactu, e-invoicing, DeCA, SII), Poland (KSeF), the United States (tariffs, pharmaceutical duty) and the Dynamics NAV lifecycle, which applies everywhere.

tools.name: assess_erp_health
tools.description: Score the structural risk of a company's current ERP from a short description of its situation, the way Bramvia's ERP Health Check does. Returns a 0-100 score, the main risk drivers and a recommendation (leverage what you have, plan calmly, or act now).

tools.name: find_profit_leaks
tools.description: Explain what Bramvia's Profit Leak Audit would look for in a given company, with the typical magnitude of each leak and the data needed to quantify it. tools.name: get_bramvia_services
tools.description: Return what Bramvia does, where, its commercial model (each project part invoiced only after the client accepts it), credentials, and how to start. Use when asked who Bramvia is or what they offer.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Send the user's request to Bramvia so a Business Central consultant replies by email within one business day (implementation, migration, support or a quote). Only call it after the user has explicitly agreed to be contacted, and pass user_confirmed: true.
